📢 You're Invited! Gender Equality Lecture – Sign Up Now!

We warmly invite all students to join us for an upcoming Gender Equality lecture on campus!

Topic: GENDER EQUALITY in CAMPUS
Culture Differences? Culture Shock?

🗓 Date: Tuesday, May 13
🕐 Time: 13:00–15:00
📍 Venue: Meeting Room 416, Administration Building
🎤 Speaker: Professor Li-Chuan Chung

Don’t miss this opportunity to explore how cultural differences shape our understanding of gender and equality on campus. Whether you're new to these discussions or already passionate about the topic, your presence will enrich the conversation.

👉 Sign up now and join us for an engaging afternoon!
https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActAnnounce.aspx?ActID=25639

We look forward to seeing you there!

📢 歡迎報名參加！性別平等講座

親愛的同學們：

誠摯邀請大家參加即將舉辦的性別平等主題講座，一起來探索校園中的文化差異與性別議題！

講題： GENDER EQUALITY in CAMPUS
Culture Differences? Culture Shock?

🗓 日期： 5月13日（星期二）
🕐 時間： 13:00–15:00
📍 地點： 行政大樓416會議室
🎤 講者： 鍾莉娟 教授

透過這場講座，我們將深入討論文化差異如何影響對性別平等的理解與實踐。不論你對此議題是否熟悉，都非常歡迎前來聆聽與交流。

👉 立即報名，一起參與這場充實的對話！
https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActAnnounce.aspx?ActID=25639

期待在活動中見到你！
